meta.title: LipoNexus | Blood Test for Early Detection of Fatty Liver Disease
meta.description: LipoNexus is developing a highly accurate non-invasive blood test for early detection and assessment of Fatty Liver Disease through inflammatory lipid biomarkers.

hero.headline: Blood Test for Early Detection of Fatty Liver Disease
hero.subheadline: Highly accurate non-invasive blood test for early detection and assessment of Fatty Liver Disease through inflammatory lipid biomarkers.

problem.headline: Fatty Liver Disease: A Silent Epidemic
problem.body: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) affects over 1 billion people worldwide, yet the majority remain undiagnosed until significant liver damage has occurred. Current diagnostic tools — liver biopsy and imaging — are expensive, invasive, operator-dependent, and often inaccessible.

solution.headline: A Better Way to Detect Liver Disease
solution.body: LipoNexus leverages proprietary inflammatory lipid biomarker signatures to deliver a simple, accurate blood test. Our approach enables earlier diagnosis, disease staging, and treatment monitoring — without the need for imaging or biopsy.

features.title: Non-Invasive
features.description: A simple blood draw replaces costly and painful liver biopsies or imaging procedures.

features.title: Highly Accurate
features.description: Proprietary inflammatory lipid biomarker panel validated against gold-standard histology.

features.title: Early Detection
features.description: Identify disease at early, reversible stages — before symptoms or organ damage appear.

features.title: Disease Staging
features.description: Assess severity and monitor treatment response over time with quantitative scores.

team.headline: Led by Experts in Diagnostics & Liver Biology
team.subheadline: Our leadership brings together deep expertise in lipid biochemistry, clinical diagnostics, and biotech commercialization.

cta.headline: Ready to Partner or Invest?
cta.body: We are actively seeking strategic partners, collaborators, and investors to help bring this breakthrough diagnostic to patients worldwide.
